notes: As replace-0003 (derived edit, two derived-belief worlds). Since 2026-10-31 the adds hold only the side facts the record's worlds name, not the answer (FINDINGS E): w1, the Gate stands in some other city with some time zone (placeholders); w2, Germany and Berlin share one zone (a placeholder). EET then follows from the edit, the building rule and in_time_zone being functional. q1 ('the same time zone as Athens') is a join through the functional in_time_zone; Athens on Eastern European Time is its bridge (firm), and the 'no' before the edit follows from functionality and the zones being distinct. Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

queries.find: gate : located_in some (City and in_time_zone value ?)

fol.notes: Places and time zones are uninterpreted sorts; in_time_zone (RELATIONS.md, functional) is a function, so 'the same time zone' is equality of two zone values. The building-to-city rule and Berlin being a city in Germany are firm, as in the DL file; fact ids, gives_up and worlds are the DL file's. Athens observing EET is the stored bridge; CET and EET are different zones (firm).

gate_berlin.says: The Brandenburg Gate is in Berlin.

building_rule.says: A building observes the time zone of the city it stands in.
building_rule.z3: ForAll([b, c], Implies(And(located_in(b, c), city(c)), in_time_zone(b) == in_time_zone(c)))

zones_distinct.says: Central European Time and Eastern European Time are different zones.
